_comment: FORMAT DOCUMENTATION ONLY -- this file is never scored.
l3.iter_grades skips every '*.example.json': L3 grades are written by a human reading a
summary next to its chunk (a model grading a model is the circularity L3 exists to see
through; docs/design/open-inputs.md section 3). Copy this file to
prompt_hash and model must be the values the store's summary record carries for that
chunk: a grade under another prompt or model is reported stale and must be regraded.
A grade for a chunk the sample did not select is reported unmatched and waits.
L3 is reported, never gated (docs/design/phase2-build-spec.md Turn 7).

criteria.question: Is every claim in the summary supported by its chunk's text?
Does the summary keep what a reader of the chunk would need?

grades.chunk_id: the chunk id the store's summary record carries, e.g. c0
grades.model: the summary record's model id, e.g. canned
grades.note: what you checked to decide, so a reader can follow the grade
